原因是我们会把Claude Code托管在LobeHub里，通过Lobe AI这个Agent可以自动进行任务的分配和管理，当触发limit之后可以自动等待额度重置后继续进行。

人还是那些人，每个月还是 200 美元的 Claude Code，但系统开始 24 小时持续推进任务，这就是最大的区别。

text:
一个抖音模板，挣了大约1.6w，核心只是一段200字的提示词。

这个AI模板是我在抖音无意中刷到的，连续刷到了4-5次，看了一下使用人数有100w+了。之前都没有详细了解过，看了详情才了解这类特效都是有创作者开发的，并且有专门的平台和创作激励（图二图三）。

官方的创作平台叫「像塑」，应用商店都能搜到，下载软件+提交作品并上线就有30元，字节跳动还是太大方了👍我尝试了一下，发布一个这样的纯提示词模板，5分钟就能搞定，40w投稿就有6000¥，100w跟拍就有10000¥，我的「照样拍」插件一天能做100套。

盈利的重点在于挖掘抖音用户群体的喜好，批量反推出这类爆款图片的提示词，持续的通过自己的抖音号发布视频吸引人来跟拍。

🔥这个爆款模板提示词我放到下面了：

将素材 1人物的样貌替换到素材 2中，生成站姐视角的远景随手拍照片，呈现一个萌萌的年轻女孩子站在强烈日照的街头，白皙皮肤，浓密黑发，斜刘海，五官精致像洋娃娃，佩戴有个性的银色项链与手链，背着时尚艺术感的粉色系小包；她身旁有个小助理，人物较小但能辨认出陪同姿态。女生手舞足蹈，表情激动，像被突然拍到，画面带不小心按到快门的真实失败感，运动模糊明显，面部光线不均，局部轻微曝光过度，角度随意略歪，手机抓拍质感，高反差，真实生活摄影，低修图感，细节自然，粉色系，低饱和低画质，微糊，ccd风，古早，亚文化，梦核，虚拟感

text:
卧槽，美股半导体被中国光刻机砸盘了。。

据The Information报道，中国一家国资背景企业已经开始小批量生产国产浸没式DUV光刻机。

今年预计生产约5台，2027年增加到20台，计划交付给中芯国际、华虹和长鑫存储。

机器目前在性能、可靠性和制造质量上仍然落后于ASML，距离真正成熟还有很长一段路。

只看这几个数字，市场似乎确实反应过度了。

5台机器，性能还不如ASML，怎么可能威胁一家垄断全球高端光刻机市场几十年的公司？

但资本市场交易的是未来。

实验室里造出一台样机，只能证明技术路线勉强可行。

真正送进中芯、华虹和长鑫的生产线，经过精度、稳定性、良率和设备兼容性的长期验证，再根据客户反馈不断修改，才意味着国产光刻机开始建立完整的产业迭代闭环。

第一批机器可能很差，产量也少得可怜。

但只要能够在晶圆厂里跑起来，后面就会产生真实数据、客户反馈、供应链订单和工程师经验。

下一代机器的研发，也终于不用继续对着实验室参数闭门造车。

更关键的是，西方每收紧一次出口限制，都在替国产设备创造一个必须被使用、必须被改进的市场。

ASML短期内依然没有真正的对手。

text:
RLM 架构的提出者 Alex L. Zhang 在最新的博客里，分享了他实践 了 Agent Harness 架构的经验。

他用数学框架论证了一件事：一个好的 harness 能让模型把两个看上去完全不同的任务，但能够像资深专家一样将它们看成「同一个」。

Alex L. Zhang 用等价类和同构给了这个直觉一个严格的描述。

《语言模型 Harness 是组合泛化器》

Alex L. Zhang，2026 年

问题

现代 post-training 已经变成了一种蛮力范式：堆更多的环境、更长的训练视野。为什么？因为前沿 Transformer 在组合泛化——将已学到的能力组合起来解决新问题——这一点上依然很弱。

过去几年，我们通过给 Transformer 加 scaffold 来攻克更难的任务——先是思维链，再是工具调用。但泛化本身一直留给了底层的神经网络和它 2017 年的 token 级归纳偏见。这让每个新领域都要求自己的训练数据投入——scaling 的回报递减。

核心论点

更好的泛化应该是 harness 的活。harness 是那个坐在外部世界和神经网络之间的程序——它决定如何把任意长度和复杂度的环境状态编码成一个或多次 LLM 输入，以及如何决定下一步行动。

"harness 的首要职责应该是承载一个更高层次的归纳偏见，能够将不熟悉、复杂的问题，简化成底层神经网络已经熟悉的问题的组合。"

具体来说，一个好的 harness 应该让每一次对底层 Transformer 的调用都处于"局部 in-distribution"——即每次调用处理的 prompt 在模型的训练数据范围内。一个经常被忽略的事实是：一个好的 harness 可以把那些看起来需要 post-training 突破的问题，简化成现有模型的基础能力。

RLM（递归语言模型）

RLM 是一个具体的 harness 实例，它做两件事：

1. 上下文卸载（Context Offloading）：把输入特定的上下文作为符号变量传递出去，根模型调用不直接看到它。这样两个结构相似但领域不同的任务，在根模型的上下文窗口里看起来 token 级别一模一样。

2. 程序化子 agent 调用（Programmatic Sub-Agent Calling）：中间计算和信息存在 REPL 里，不被塞回主上下文。标准 agent 用工具调用的信息直接回到主上下文，改变了输出分布。RLM 的子调用让主上下文避开任务特定信息。

这让 harness 能够在轨迹空间上诱导等价类：两个共享潜在结构但领域完全不同的任务（比如 BrowseComp-Plus 的信息搜寻和 OOLONG 的 TREC 问题聚合），在根 LM 眼里是同构的——字面意思上的同构，token 级别相同。

实验结果

RL 训练只在短任务上进行，但在以下维度实现泛化：

长度泛化：训练任务 8-32 倍长的 held-out 任务上保持性能。如果 RLM 学会了一个与长度无关的策略，它直接泛化到更长长度。

策略泛化（跨领域）：在三个场景下验证——底层策略相同（聚合、搜索过滤、MapReduce），但输入领域完全不同：
• OOLONG：TREC 问题 → spam 检测问题
• OBLIQ-Bench：写作作者识别 → 数学推理模式匹配
• OBLIQ-Bench Descriptive：Twitter 立场检测 → Wildchat 错误查找

结果：同样训练量的提升，RLM harness 的泛化收益大约是裸 Transformer 的 10 倍。

更深层的含义

作者很小心地没有掉进"我们应该都去手工设计 harness 策略"的陷阱。他的真论点不是"handcrafted > learned"。而是：

"Scaling 数据仍然是进步的最大驱动力，但我们将数据输入的那个机器的结构和它的归纳偏见，将决定这个 scaling 的系数。"

Transformer 的设计空间——主要由可微神经元算子组成——缺少某种根本性的东西。但语言作为一个强大的底层基础，已经让我们能在数年间大规模训练。现在，AI 系统的架构不再被限制在简单的可微算子上。我们可以通过 RL 端到端地训练编码了更高层次、更符号化的归纳偏见的系统。

RLM 是这个方向的一个具体路径。通过上下文卸载和程序化子 agent，它做到了 Transformer 做不好的事：把不同但结构化相似的任务，压缩到同一 token 轨迹上，让 RL 在更小的数据上也能泛化。

#Harness工程 #组合泛化 #RLM

text:
这两天跟一个朋友聊天，他说公司有个默契：

大家都会用 AI，但在领导面前都说不会。

私下半天做完一天的活，领导来了就换回原始工作方式，被问起统一说 AI 不好用。

一旦承认 AI 提高了效率，省下来的不会是时间，只会招来领导给安排更多工作。

所以哪怕现在 AI 可以将个人效率不断地提高，但在这种制度和竞争状态下，这样的提效并不现实。

非常吊诡的是，Opus 5 几乎在每一项指标上都超越了 Fable 5 
也许这只能说明我们的所有指标都已经失效了
而且 Claude 系列的模型用起来的味道不太对劲，现在味道比较对的是 Kimi 和 Grok

quotedTweet.text:
opus 5 is a VERY interesting release for a few reasons

1. it showed that the general benchmarks we use today are almost completely useless now

opus 5 is nowhere near fable in practical use, not even close. anyone who’s used it meaningfully can tell this very quickly after a few tasks. yet opus beats fable on many benchmarks

i now trust domain specific benchmarks built with private datasets a lot more than the popular ones. perhaps the future is everyone running their own evals because the public ones are really not telling us much

2. it seems with the 5 series, anthropic is trying a new way of training models

previously, the same generation of sonnet and opus were often released at the same time or sonnet comes out before opus, which indicates sonnet and opus were trained by separate pipelines in parallel

with the 5 series, it was very clear that they trained mythos first, and then distilled it into sonnet and opus. it seems this approach has a big influence on the models

seeing sonnet 5 being a flop and opus 5 getting pretty mixed reviews already, i’m not sure this is working out

3. “how pleasant is it to work with the model” used to be a strength in claude, but now it’s not. honestly, grok is my favorite right now on the “pleasant” dimension. kimi is not bad either

it feels like both anthropic and openai are giving RLHF less care, in favor of scalable RL that’s machine verifiable

this almost looks like AI is directing humans to build a world that’s more friendly for machines rather than humans, and most humans don’t even realize they are being manipulated to help with that

almost every new generation of frontier models now talk more jargons, need more steering to do what you want, and are just less fun to work with

if this continues, AI will start to speak their own language that looks like English but average humans can’t understand. they will choose to do things that their human user never asked for. are we already failing at alignment?

text: 现在的市场是十年一遇的大机会！华尔街的贪婪，把SpaceX IPO定在135这个近乎变态的价格。其实是对贪婪的散户的定点收割。高级的贪婪收割低级的贪婪，倒也无可厚非。只是我们需要看透支配市场的宏观逻辑，不被反常的表象和机构的陷阱所迷惑，就会发现现在这个充满投机的市场是难得一遇的大机会。没有贪婪的愚蠢资金，就没有理性的聪明资金的超额收益。市场中的贪婪和杠杆全都是我们的燃料。现在是我所说的“两个阶段三步走”的第一步，所以是超宽幅震荡、AI上游与现金牛的跷跷板行情。所以不必紧张，可以有纪律的做波段（不拿新增资金玩）。我最近就在玩美光和Adobe的来回切换。会员Space应该都知道我上个礼拜，卖Adobe买MU，又卖了MU买Adobe，不亦乐乎。而且我还说，如果周一上游继续跌，我会再把一部分从Adobe切换回MU。一定要控制好仓位，尤其是要留好现金，直到我们进入三步走的第二步，现金就会派上用场。高波不是不可以玩期权，但要谨慎。

text:
不提北大，不怪王虹。

王虹。16岁高考，数学系没考上，被调剂到地球科学。大二转系才进的数学。

保研失败。勉强毕业。去了法国，压力大到不做数学了，跑去学建筑。半年后发现建筑也难，又回来了。

这些年没有一个人拉过她。没有一个所谓的伯乐。没有什么体制的培养。全是自己死扛。

接着她解了一个困了数学界100年的题。
菲尔兹奖。历史第三个女性。中国籍第一次。

现在所有人都来了。
北大发祝贺：「我们的校友。」
马克龙打电话：「法国教育的卓越。」
官媒加粗红字：「中国数学的历史性突破。」

说实话看着挺恶心的。

她挣扎的时候你们在干嘛。她保研失败的时候谁帮她说了一句话。她对着镜子怀疑自己是不是该放弃的那些晚上，谁他妈在乎过。

现在人家成了。都来了。全是她的恩人。全是她的母校。

王虹自己怎么说的？「我在北大一直在苦苦挣扎，能生存下来就不错了。」获奖感言感谢了巴黎，感谢了纽约，没提北大。

不提北大，不怪王虹。

text:
终于有一个可以复刻 Apple 设计风格的 Skill 了。
Apple 的一些视觉风格，给人的感觉就是很舒服。

apple-design ，它的来源主要来自 Apple 的 WWDC 设计演讲，尤其是流体界面、音频触觉反馈、字体细节、伟大设计原则这些内容。

作者把这些经验整理成 17 条设计和动效原则，再转换成 Web 里能落地的写法。

Skill 最核心的理念有那么几个。

比如界面要从用户当前的动作里长出来。

它不追求把动画做得花，但是要让界面始终保持可控。

它还包括材质和层级。

导航栏、工具栏、弹层这些浮动区域，可以用 backdrop-filter 做出半透明的层，但不能一层一层叠到看不清。

使用方式很简单。

npx skills@latest add emilkowalski/skills

装好之后，就可以在做界面时调用 apple-design。

text:
王虹的博士老板，Larry Guth，是典型的学二代。Larry的爸爸就是提出著名的“宇宙暴涨理论”的天体物理学家Alan Guth。当年古斯在1979年提出暴涨理论，有点像科幻小说，虽然能够很好地解释大爆炸后宇宙空间的平坦性和各向同性，但是它带来的问题，比解决的问题更多。鉴于物理学已经濒临脑死亡，宇宙暴涨理论属于子孙后代的物理学，在我们的时代只能依旧被处理成科幻小说。

古斯的科幻小说让他成为了MIT的物理学教授。他的儿子Larry Guth后来主攻数学，就在老爹物理系隔壁的数学系读博士，属于典型的学二代。Larry Guth后来去了很多地方，兜兜转转又回到了MIT。

result.text:
王虹的博士老板，Larry Guth，是典型的学二代。Larry的爸爸就是提出著名的“宇宙暴涨理论”的天体物理学家Alan Guth。当年古斯在1979年提出暴涨理论，有点像科幻小说，虽然能够很好地解释大爆炸后宇宙空间的平坦性和各向同性，但是它带来的问题，比解决的问题更多。鉴于物理学已经濒临脑死亡，宇宙暴涨理论属于子孙后代的物理学，在我们的时代只能依旧被处理成科幻小说。

古斯的科幻小说让他成为了MIT的物理学教授。他的儿子Larry Guth后来主攻数学，就在老爹物理系隔壁的数学系读博士，属于典型的学二代。Larry Guth后来去了很多地方，兜兜转转又回到了MIT。

text:
给Codex接了个155K Star的爬虫神器，AI终于不瞎了。

事情是这样的。我天天让Codex联网找资料、翻文档、盯GitHub热榜。但Codex自带的联网功能碰到JS渲染的页面直接抓瞎——抓回来一个空壳，还一本正经告诉我「这页面没内容」。

后来接了Firecrawl，同一个页面干净的Markdown秒出。这玩意儿现在155K Star，GitHub全站前100。

━━━ 它是干嘛的

说白了就是把网页变成AI能看懂的样子。你给它一个URL，它还你干净的Markdown、结构化JSON或者截图。导航栏、广告、弹窗全过滤掉，官方说输入token能省93%。

数据很硬：125万开发者、15万家公司、npm+PyPI每周250万下载。

━━━ 六个核心功能

1️⃣ Scrape — 抓单页
最常用的。JS渲染的页面自动渲染完再抠，反爬代理全不用管。还能挂schema按字段返回JSON，比如只要标题和价格。网页上挂的PDF/DOCX直接解析，白皮书和财报不用下载处理了。

2️⃣ Crawl — 爬整站
给起始URL，顺着链接把整个网站抓回来。深度、页面数、路径过滤都能配。做RAG知识库的时候，导入整个文档站就一条命令。

3️⃣ Map — 列出全站URL
不抓内容，先把域名下所有URL列出来，秒回。还能带搜索词，比如只列出跟定价相关的页面。做竞品监控的时候省了大事。

4️⃣ Search — 网页搜索
直接给关键词搜索，返回每条结果的完整页面内容。老做法是搜一遍再抓一遍，它一步出结果，适合深度研究类Agent。

5️⃣ Agent — 自动干活
URL都不用给。说「找一下Notion的定价方案」，它自己去搜去读，返回结果加来源链接。模型两档：spark-1-mini便宜60%日常够用，spark-1-pro跨站对比时用。

6️⃣ Interact — 页面交互
有些数据藏在点击后面——电商搜索结果、翻页列表。用人话指挥它「搜一下机械键盘，点第一个结果」，它真去操作页面，返回还能看实时浏览器画面。第一次看到这个live view的时候我截了图。

npx -y firecrawl-cli@latest init --all --browser

━━━ 实际用起来

text:
We're only year 3 of a decade (if not multi-decades) long transformation of work.

3 years ago we bet on building an horizontal platform for work with agents, a chance to invent a new operating system for companies, from scratch, with AI as a fundamental premise. Many people considered us crazy for going after that, praising verticalized AI products as the winning strategy. But here's the thing: the time horizon of tasks successfully handled by agents has been predictively increasing form minutes to hours and will in all likelihood reach the equivalent of days and weeks of human work equivalent in the coming quarters.

This is were verticalized and/or single-player AI falls short. Single-player tools, one person, one agent, confined to your machine is the wrong architecture for what's coming. We're shifting from using AI to produce things, to managing fleets of agents that do the producing. 3 years ago I wrote[1]:

"ChatGPT is the Pong of LLMs. [...] Imagine, one day we'll get the DOOM, Civ, Red Alert, and Counter Strike of LLMs. Let alone multiplayer modes."

Weeks long tasks in companies are inherently collaborative and mechanically spanning multiple teams. The new bottleneck in harnessing agents within organizations is coordination: multiple humans and multiple agents need to work together, with shared context, shared tools, shared goals. Agents that can hand work off to other agents or surface decisions to the right person at the right time. Humans who can review, steer, and step in without losing the thread. Teams that can run parallel workstreams and actually stay aligned. 

This is Multiplayer AI, and that's what we've been building at Dust. 

Across Datadog, Clay, Persona, 1Password, Doctolib and 3,000+ organizations globally, we've watched teams figure out what this looks like in practice. 300,000+ agents deployed. 70% weekly active. 240%+ NRR.

Today we're announcing a $40M Series B with Abstract, Sequoia, Snowflake, and Datadog to accelerate our vision.

Designing the right interfaces for multiplayer AI is the next frontier.  Join us to redefine work by defining multiplayer AI.

手贱把 macOS 升到了 27 beta，Xcode 跟着变 beta，拿 Codex 测 App 疯狂踩坑。
但也正因为折腾了这一圈，翻到苹果在 WWDC 上发的 Xcode MCP。
授权之后 Codex / Claude 能直接连进 Xcode，读写项目、构建、测试、验证。

接入就 3 步：
1、Xcode → Settings → Intelligence，打开「Allow external agents to use Xcode tools」
2、终端：codex mcp add xcode -- xcrun mcpbridge
3、codex mcp list 确认

比较狠的是还内置了 7 个官方 Skills：
SwiftUI 最佳实践、最新 API 迁移、UIKit 现代化、测试、安全审计、C 边界安全、真机/模拟器交互。

说白了，Agent 以后干活用的就是苹果官方那套攒了多年的工程规范。

已经有人从Xcode导出来开源了：
https://t.co/YMLJxltfWY

text:
Friendship with God 

The secret of the Lord is for those who fear Him,
   And He will make them know His covenant.
—Psalm 25:14 (ESV)

The Hebrew word translated here as “secret” is alternatively rendered in English as “friendship,” “intimacy,” or “counsel.” The idea is one of close familiarity, of a confidant, of two people facing and speaking directly to one another. God would speak to Moses “face to face, just as a man speaks to his friend” (Ex. 33:11).

To know the secret of the Lord is to know His heart. It is to understand not just what He does, but who He is and what He is like. A true friend shares both his joys and his sorrows, his delights and his sufferings. Jesus welcomes us into such intimacy with Him that we are invited to partake in what He experiences, including His rejoicings in new life and restoration, His tears of grief over sin and its consequences, and the pain of His rejection by those whom He loves.

As His friend, He invites us to share our secrets with Him. While it is true that nothing is hidden from His sight, something powerful happens when we intentionally bring to Him our darkest fear, our deepest regret, and our most shameful sin. In that moment, sin is cleansed, fears dissolve, tears of mourning turn to tears of joy. But He also desires us to share our present joys, our hopes for the future and the hidden desires of our heart. He enters them with us.

Pray we learn how to bring Him our hearts daily. Every morning, each night, and throughout the day, practice the intimacy of exposing your heart to the Lord. Here there is no shame or embarrassment, only the welcome embrace of the One who knows and cares.

David says that in this process we will learn His covenant. That is, we will begin to understand the fathomless depths of His love, the contractual certainty of His promises, and the unchanging nature of His steadfast lovingkindness. We will know His heart; and we will know what He is doing on the earth.

Jesus gives us this as a promise. He said, “No longer do I call you slaves, for the slave does not know what his master is doing; but I have called you friends, for all things that I have heard from My Father I have made known to you” (Jn. 15:15). Let us walk in the friendship of Christ.

Read more and subscribe on Substack to receive Stormwall Devotional sent to your email every morning: https://t.co/uLTX97ocq4

Culture is built on one’s understanding of reality (which should be Truth), and Liturgy is built on Culture - so liturgy ultimately reflects a view about reality. The Traditional liturgy reflects a culture of absolute truth, the Novus liturgy reflects a culture of relativism.

Traditional liturgy (and the SSPX) are getting beat up on by the Vatican because modernists hate absolute truth, and modernists are in control of the Church right now.

Excommunication is not a causal event, but a juridical recognition of varying accuracy."

text:
Pureskin 2-min VSL Analysis (How To Adapt & Model A “High Production” Style)

"Break down the foookin ads... 

"Study them... 

"hand copy sales letterzZZZ... 

alright alright alright mr ecom bro... chill, let's get to it

We’ll look at how the visuals of pureskin contribute to the usual ‘direct response’ techniques, and think about the ‘creative’ logistics that go into producing an ad like this, plus, we’ll also explore some of the inspo / cultural references / shot styles that are ‘baked’ into the vsl itself.

5 Things we cover: 

1) Video Editing Techniques - Spam Match Cuts 

2) Scene Management - How to pick the right sets to tell your story 

3) Sound Design: Teasing your audience's ears before the climax 

4) Dramatic Demonstrations of Disgust 

5) Copy & Positioning Notes: 

6) Playbook for selling to gen z (maybe) who knew we would get tired of 45 minute VSLs? 

Video Editing Stuff: Match Cuts, Pacing & Breaking The Fourth Wall.

The first 5 seconds mirror a native ‘instagram’ and snapchat reel, after that the sneeze happens. And then a change in camera quality, with a sudden change in audio quality creates a sudden ‘shift’ in pace.
Also another technique that’s used or ‘threaded’ throughout the video is the ‘uncanny voiceover’.
During the video, audio – the ‘rising cymbals’ are used to show the sudden ‘increase’ in importance, or to audibly ‘tell’ the story of the next scene that’s on the edge.
Film Vibes Scene Swiper: https://t.co/yhTl4ISmxW
Match Cut Youtube Tutorial: https://t.co/1Yrf3aNsx7

Scene Management: The scenes are always fresh, new, and interesting. This means that no ‘backdrop’ is repeated to the point it gets too boring, and the distance from the camera – to the subject itself changes.

Generally it appears that all of the action is happening within the middle of the scene – i.e. middle third of the screen. The eye is never made to move from that one focal point.

All of the action, all of the scenes – and the most important details UV bacteria, the sudden sneeze, the towel, they’re all placed in ‘odd’ angles within the central third of the horizontal video. The text ‘hovers’ around the centre point, and comes in at odd angles, to support the main idea, but never to overwhelm the visual.

They also transition their scenes in odd ways, from different angles. The principle, it appears to be, is to find the most ‘odd’ yet also relevant way to tell the story.  At 0:40, the speaker is in the bathroom, and then the towel comes in from the right side of the scene, while the speaker ducks.

Odd transition, but it follows from the original problem which is the towel and it’s bacteria.

Sound design:
As for the ‘foley’ – there’s quite a high attention to detail to the little ‘crisps’ especially the ‘sneezes’ throughout the edit. This is when a point is made, when the visual matches the copy, matches the pacing. These 3 layers ‘stacking’ on top of each other, creates a pretty sick effect.

Also, it’s pretty obvious that the entire ‘ad’ is voice-overed, which does create that uncanny effect, and it pays off at the end, when the founder does ‘introduce the discount’ and lets you in on the ‘show’ that they’ve put together for you, it creates an effect when the founder IS talking directly to the camera – when it goes back to ‘normal’ that you were ‘let in’ on that entire scene.

Dramatic Demonstrations:

This ad reminds me of the VKTRY insole’s ads (Match Cut Heavy)  and also the original life straw ads, where the founder drinks out of McDonald's toilet, not sure where the video is.

Copywriting / Storytelling Elements:

As for the copy, what we’re selling is the hidden source of bacteria, that’s the big idea – I think that the campaign would’ve likely flopped, if not for the visual video editing, and if not for the storytelling, and the dramatization of where the bacteria comes from.
It also appears that with the types of characters that they’re casting on their ads, they’re going for the sub 35 millennials to gen Z market, which is a little different from the usual boomer ads, that we see old school vsl’s run to.

Implications:

Selling to younger audiences may require more attention to detail, transition cuts, and also ‘fancyness’ in order to hook their attention. It seems that both VKTRY insoles (high school players, direct to the kids), and pureskin (direct to consumer, likely <35) require a ‘prettier’ playbook, than your usual boomer styled problem aware ad.
Hey, I’ve done ugly ads for really long. It would be nice to do pretty sometimes lol, and to have it perform too. Market is king. Test faster. Yolo, run ads or whatever.
Good luck have fun.

Z.

I obviously told him I’m waiting, but are these idiots not looking at any data? Is their model just “buy and wait,” and they charge me for that?

This is my first year with them. For those who are interested, their end-of-year targets are 7800, with a 25% probability of 8300 on the S&P.

I just want to know: is their strategy simply always buy, and if something goes wrong they just tell you “buying at all-time highs doesn’t matter because it will go higher,” or do they ever wait for a correction?

I’m really pissed about it. Any thoughts?
